summary: CASE-08 completed all 54 release and archive assertions successfully, but the serial release-proof test process exceeded the approved 900-second runner timeout and was terminated with SIGTERM.
root_cause: The release-proof suite places 43 synchronous top-level tests in one Node test file, so Node cannot distribute those tests across worker processes. The resulting serial critical path takes longer than the approved CASE-08 timeout even though every underlying assertion passes; this is a test-runner organization defect rather than a product implementation failure.
